title: Engine Ignition Operation and Components — 2.3L EcoBoost (231kW/314PS)
introduction:
I read an ignition reference with two questions in mind: how does the system work, and what job belongs to each component? A collection of part names is only the cast list; the operating explanation supplies the plot under the hood.

For this engine, both explanations are in the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual. This page directs you there. It supplies no ignition-component inventory, electrical test values or replacement procedure.

edits.text: For the engine-ignition system-operation explanation, consult the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual, Section 1, Description and Operation.
edits.why: The operating explanation establishes the system’s overall behavior before you focus on individual components.

edits.text: For descriptions of the engine-ignition components, consult the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual, Section 1, Description and Operation.
edits.why: Component descriptions connect each part’s identity with its role in the ignition system.
